title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: A yield-based insurance scheme which aims to provide financial support to farmers suffering from crop loss/damage arising out of unforeseen events.
benefits: Financial support for crop loss, subsidized premiums for farmers.
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
howToApply: Apply online through the PMFBY portal or via designated banks and insurance agents.

title: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Income support of Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments to all landholding farmer families.
benefits: Direct income support of Rs. 6,000 per annum.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmer families with combined landholding up to 2 hectares.
howToApply: Register on the PM-Kisan portal or through Common Service Centres (CSCs).

title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
description: Provides farmers with timely access to credit for their cultivation and other needs including purchase of inputs.
benefits: Low interest rates, flexible repayment, coverage for crop insurance.
eligibility: All farmers – individuals/joint borrowers who are owner cultivators.
howToApply: Approach any commercial bank, RRB, or cooperative bank to apply.

title: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)
description: Focuses on 'Har Khet Ko Pani' (Water for every field) and improving water use efficiency 'Per Drop More Crop'.
benefits: Subsidies for micro-irrigation systems like drip and sprinkler irrigation.
eligibility: All farmers having own land or leased land.
howToApply: Apply through the State Agriculture Department or PMKSY official portal.

title: PM-e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
description: A pan-India electronic trading portal which networks the existing APMC mandis to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities.
benefits: Provides farmers with better price discovery, eliminates middlemen, and ensures transparency in trade.
eligibility: Registered farmers and traders in the participating states.
howToApply: Farmers can register through their local Agricultural Produce Market Committee (APMC).

title: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: The scheme provides soil health cards to farmers which contain information about their soil's nutrient content and recommend appropriate remedial measures.
benefits: Promotes balanced use of fertilizers, improves soil health, and increases crop yields.
howToApply: Farmers can get their soil tested at government soil testing laboratories and obtain the card.

title: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
description: A national mission for financial inclusion that ensures access to financial services, namely banking, savings & deposit accounts, remittance, credit, insurance, and pension in an affordable manner.
benefits: Zero balance accounts, accidental insurance coverage, and easy access to credit.
eligibility: All Indian citizens above 10 years of age.
howToApply: Open an account at any bank or Common Service Centre (CSC).

title: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
description: A medium- to long-term debt financing facility for investment in building post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
benefits: Subsidized interest rates, credit guarantee, and support for cold storage, processing units, etc.
eligibility: Farmers, FPOs, and entrepreneurs involved in agriculture.
howToApply: Apply through participating banks and financial institutions.

title: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
description: A scheme to promote organic farming in the country by supporting the development of organic production in a participatory mode.
benefits: Financial assistance for organic inputs, certification support, and market linkage.
eligibility: Farmers willing to adopt organic farming methods.
howToApply: Apply through the District Agriculture Officer or State Nodal Agency.

title: National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture (NMSA)
description: Aims to promote sustainable agriculture through the integration of technology, climate-smart practices, and efficient resource management.
benefits: Supports practices like micro-irrigation, soil health management, and farm mechanization.
howToApply: Apply through the State Agriculture Department's online portal.
